title: Successive root-power prefixes
statement: Let $\ell$ be a nonnegative integer, let $m,y$ be length-$\ell$ vectors over $\mathbb F_2$, and let $r$ be a nonnegative integer. In the quotient obtained by adjoining a root $\alpha$ of $X^\ell+\sum_{i<\ell}m_iX^i$, the sum $\sum_{i<r+1} y_i\alpha^i$ equals $\sum_{i<r} y_i\alpha^i+y_r\alpha^r$, where coefficients beyond index $\ell-1$ are taken to be zero.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ and $y$ are length-$\ell$ vectors over $\mathbb F_2$
